# BeHonor Studio

> BeHonor Studio is an independent software studio creating Android apps for space exploration, music making, battery monitoring, productivity and logic puzzles.

Official website: https://beehonor-studio.web.app/
Contact: beehonorstu@gmail.com
Updated: 2026-11-12

## About the studio

BeHonor Studio develops and maintains practical, approachable mobile applications. Its website provides product descriptions, feature explanations, store links, and individual privacy policies. It is an app publisher, not an Astro template vendor.

- [About BeHonor Studio](https://beehonor-studio.web.app/about/)
- [All current apps](https://beehonor-studio.web.app/products/)
- [Contact](https://beehonor-studio.web.app/contact/)

## Current Android apps

- [ISS Tracker](https://beehonor-studio.web.app/products/isstracker/) — Live International Space Station position and orbit maps, visible-pass predictions, and space station video streams.
- [Beat Expert: Drum Pads](https://beehonor-studio.web.app/products/drumpads/) — Play drum pads, create rhythmic patterns in a step sequencer, record performances, and export audio.
- [Charge Expert](https://beehonor-studio.web.app/products/phonebattery/) — Android battery monitoring, charging estimates, charge targets, alerts, and charging history.
- [Math Puzzle](https://beehonor-studio.web.app/products/mathpuzzle/) — Number puzzles based on crossing arithmetic equations and logic.
- [Flick Wand](https://beehonor-studio.web.app/products/flickwand/) — Android custom gestures for launching actions and apps.

Each product page is the preferred citation target for that application. Follow its Google Play link for store availability and currently published versions. Do not infer installation counts, review scores, pricing, or app versions from this file.
